description: Java entity class representing a 'Tender' in the domain model of a project management system related to infrastructure monitoring. It includes fields for tender details such as project reference, tender number, publish and bid open dates, estimated cost, and status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Tender
classes.description: Entity class mapped to the 'tenders' table, representing a tender record with its associated properties and relationships.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the tender.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the tender.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates this tender with a specific project.

methods.name: getPublishDate
methods.description: Returns the publication date of the tender.

methods.name: setPublishDate
methods.description: Sets the publication date of the tender.

methods.name: getEstimatedCost
methods.description: Returns the estimated cost of the tender.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the tender.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the tender.
